pages.text: $(bold)Right-clicking a basin with an empty hand$() checks in order, each failure shows a hint:$(br)Dirty water → scoop it out first$(br)Empty basin → fill it with water first$(br)Not sitting on a stool → sit down$(br)Wearing boots → take them off$(br)Feet clean → no Sweaty Feet to wash$(br)All checks pass → soaking starts.

$(bold)Water vs medicinal$(): water washes Sweaty Feet; floral water poured into a water basin makes it medicinal, which cures fungus (the only cure).$(br2)$(bold)Soak progress$(): only counts while within 1.5 blocks of the basin — leaving pauses it (no reset); wearing boots also pauses it; higher levels soak longer (one base duration per level).

$(bold)Done$(): Sweaty Feet (or fungus) is cleared and the basin turns dirty — scoop it into "X's foot-washing water" with a bucket, and scoop it out to refill with fresh water.$(br2)$(bold)Your main hand must be empty$(): holding an item makes the right-click do nothing.
